slices.focus: Ayaka leads the drafting of a formal bad-weather operations manual with Mori Chisato, aiming to replace personal memory with teachable, recoverable procedure.
slices.summary: Building on a full season of proof, Ayaka leads the draft of a formal bad-weather operations manual with guidance from her former manager Mori Chisato. Key standards: 15-minute notice-update target, staged emergency cargo steps in order, and 24-hour recovery expectation after weather interruptions when sailings are feasible. Ayaka worries about the manual being too rigid or too optimistic but prioritizes explicit ownership lines and observable conditions over polished prose. She plans a front-page origin note so the manual reads as practice-based, not theoretical.
open_loops: Manual could be ignored by senior staff who prefer improvisation
24-hour recovery target may be attacked as unrealistic
Becoming the manual's author may make Ayaka the sole bottleneck for updates
decisions: Ayaka is now leading the drafting of a formal bad-weather operations manual for the Fukuoka City Ferry Terminal Operatio
